inputs.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/madworld
CF=/opt/madworld/ops/docker-compose.production.yml
DF=/opt/madworld/ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml
ENVF=/opt/madworld/.env
echo DRIFT_REPAIR_START cmd-20260908-153300-prod-abuse-schema-drift-repair
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
print('host migration present=', Path('backend/migrations/034_b10_shared_abuse_controls.sql').exists())
PY
echo '--APPLY_EXACT_034_SQL--'
docker compose -f "$CF" -f "$DF" --env-file "$ENVF" run --rm migrator python -c "from pathlib import Path; from app.infrastructure.db import create_engine_from_env; e=create_engine_from_env(); sql=Path('migrations/034_b10_shared_abuse_controls.sql').read_text(); c=e.connect(); c.exec_driver_sql(sql); c.commit(); print('034 SQL executed directly'); print(c.execute(__import__('sqlalchemy').text(\"select to_regclass('public.abuse_control_hits'), to_regclass('public.abuse_control_replays'), to_regclass('public.abuse_control_scores')\")).one()); c.close()"
echo '--RESTART_API--'
docker compose -f "$CF" -f "$DF" --env-file "$ENVF" up -d --no-build api
sleep 5
echo '--HEALTH--'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'health=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8090/health
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'ready=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8090/health/ready
echo '--PUBLIC--'
curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w 'public=%{http_code}\n' https://api.autosklo.org.ua/health
echo '--STATUS--'
docker compose -f "$CF" -f "$DF" --env-file "$ENVF" ps -a
free -m | head -2
echo DRIFT_REPAIR_DONE
